snippet.title: Absym - Official Gameplay Trailer [ Indie-Credible Showcase 2026 ]
snippet.description:
Absym is a unique souls-like that challenges you to survive between two dimensions: the decaying Nihilor and the corrupted Absymalith. Fight, explore, and use Rift Dancing to shift between worlds in real time. Every choice draws you closer to redemption... or corruption.

Official Steampage:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2863300/Absym/
